description: This file implements the core processing logic for an HTTP Basic Message Object, including functions for examining, processing, closing, producing, and serializing HTTP messages. It handles different message states, buffer descriptors, and message body processing, with mechanisms tailored for HTTP/1.1 pipelining and chunked transfer encoding.

methods.name: ULONG HttpBmoExamine(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Examines the received payload buffer to determine the current message state, identifying if headers are complete, if message body is complete, or if the message is over-packed, based on internal state and content analysis.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpBmoProcess(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo)
methods.description: Processes an incoming buffer descriptor, parses headers, transitions states, creates message body objects, and handles pipelined or chunked data according to the current message state.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpBmoCloseUp(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo)
methods.description: Finalizes the message processing on connection close, handles the last buffer descriptor, and transitions state when message ends.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpBmoProduce(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,PULONG pulSize)
methods.description: Serializes the message into a buffer for transmission, copying headers and body content.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpBmoOutputHeaders(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSerializeContext)
methods.description: Serializes the current HTTP headers either directly from the stored buffer descriptor or by reconstructing headers into a buffer and serializing it.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpBmoOutputBody(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSerializeContext)
methods.description: Serializes the message body, supporting chunked encoding and outputting data through the associated serialization interface.

methods.name: void HttpBmoSendComplete(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Sends the final chunk if chunked transfer encoding is used, signaling message completion.
